text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the 
academy—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: “—Go on! Fetch this popcorn!”

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caw, caw!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? She snatched it right out of 
mid-air in an instant!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, amazing, right? While I was giving 
them treats, they started listening to 
what I say.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right now, he's my loyal servant—dubbed 
'Bumbum'! Eventually, I'm planning to make 
him my new familiar!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: H-Huh... Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun―― You're wishing you had a familiar 
of your own now too, aren't you, Kawakami?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"N-N-N-Not at all! I-It is not as if I am 
jealous! I merely thought it was a tiny 
bit nice, is all—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I bet you're totally jealous, aren't you? 
But it's not easy, you know. Only a great 
magical girl like me can pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gnnngh~... I say~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Just then, an idea struck me. Come to 
think of it, PreFighter also had a mascot 
character—
choice_data_list:
――No, the princess has me by her side, 
woof!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Wh-What's your problem...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Gasp?! Trainer, that manner of 
speaking... could it be Sebastian, the 
butler dog from PreFy?!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's that supposed to mean...? 
Basically, you're saying you'll act as 
Kawakami's familiar instead?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san! To think you would go that 
far for me...! This princess is moved to 
tears...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, you can't catch popcorn thrown 
into the air like my Bunbun, can you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Nothing is impossible for Trainer! I am 
certain you can catch popcorn far more 
elegantly than Bunbun-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Well, isn't that interesting! If 
you're so confident, let's see what you've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, against all common sense, I 
ended up locked in a showdown against 
birds that I had zero chance of winning—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Listen up! The rules are simple! We toss 
popcorn into the air, and whoever catches 
it first wins!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Please, believe in me. 
From this moment on, you shall receive 
wings to soar through the vast skies—!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Because! Starting right now, I am going to 
be your wings!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Hyah! Go get 'em, my trusty Bunbun!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Here I come as well! Doryaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The moment I felt Kawakami Princess 
grab me with incredible strength— the next 
second, I was soaring through the sky.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! The popcorn is right before our 
eyes!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Yay, yay! As expected of you, Trainer! 
You've got a firm grip on the popcorn!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened so fast my memory's hazy, but 
apparently I managed to grab the popcorn.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Th-That's totally cheating! Kawakami just 
chucked that thing!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"No way, we're partners! Cooperating is 
the classic trope here!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the one who made that splendid 
catch was unmistakably you, Trainer! I 
won't let anyone complain!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-san... no, right now I 
shall call you Sebastian! What kind of 
amazing technique shall I show you next?!
choice_data_list:
...Next time, I at least want to use my 
legs, woof.

Please launch it high into the sky with 
all your might, woof!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Next up, how about we spice 
things up with a tag-team relay deathmatch 
on track!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! I'm gonna beat you to a pulp! 
Right, Bunbun?!

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caw!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After that, the showdown raged on until 
every muscle in our bodies felt like mush—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, as expected of Trai—Sebastian! You 
are brimming with challenging spirit, 
aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Next time, we'll launch you all the way 
into the stratosphere! Are you quite 
ready?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ready, aaand!!
choice_data_list: A a a a a a g h . . .

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on!? You've jumped way higher than 
the school building!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It was a moment that made me realize I 
shouldn't make hasty promises in the heat 
of the moment—"
